class.name: PorchlightCondition
class.brief_description: Tests one or more persistent Porchlight milestones.
class.description: A reusable condition that checks milestone state stored by [PorchlightProgress]. [member match_mode] determines whether the condition checks the single [member milestone], requires all entries in [member milestones], or accepts any entry in [member milestones]. Enable [member inverted] to negate the final result. Invalid conditions always return [code]false[/code], even when inverted.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of the configured condition. Invalid single conditions return [code]No milestone selected.[/code]. Invalid composite conditions return [code]No milestones selected.[/code].

method.name: is_met
method.description: Returns whether the current persistent milestone state satisfies this condition. In [constant MATCH_SINGLE] mode, [member milestone] must be complete. In [constant MATCH_ALL] mode, every entry in [member milestones] must be complete. In [constant MATCH_ANY] mode, at least one entry in [member milestones] must be complete. When [member inverted] is [code]true[/code], the aggregate result is negated. An inverted [constant MATCH_ALL] condition is therefore met when at least one configured milestone is incomplete. An inverted [constant MATCH_ANY] condition is met when none of the configured milestones are complete. Returns [code]false[/code] if the condition is invalid or the [PorchlightProgress] singleton is unavailable.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether this condition has the milestone data required by its current [member match_mode]. [constant MATCH_SINGLE] requires a nonempty [member milestone]. [constant MATCH_ALL] and [constant MATCH_ANY] require at least one normalized entry in [member milestones].

method.name: references_milestone
method.description: Returns whether this condition observes [param milestone]. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed from [param milestone] before comparison. In [constant MATCH_SINGLE] mode, it is compared with [member milestone]. In composite modes, it is searched for in [member milestones]. Returns [code]false[/code] for an empty normalized milestone name.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], negates the final result produced by [member match_mode]. Invalid conditions remain unmet rather than becoming true through inversion.
Determines how milestone state is evaluated. [constant MATCH_SINGLE] uses [member milestone]. [constant MATCH_ALL] and [constant MATCH_ANY] use [member milestones].
The milestone checked in [constant MATCH_SINGLE] mode. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed when assigned. This property is ignored by [constant MATCH_ALL] and [constant MATCH_ANY].

The milestones checked in [constant MATCH_ALL] and [constant MATCH_ANY] modes. Assigned entries are trimmed, empty entries are removed, and duplicate names are discarded while preserving their first occurrence. This property is ignored by [constant MATCH_SINGLE].

constants.constant: Checks whether the single [member milestone] is complete.
Checks whether every entry in [member milestones] is complete.
Checks whether at least one entry in [member milestones] is complete.
